elements.text: Welcome and thank you for participating in the Mindtrails study! You have been randomly assigned to the control group, which means you will continue to manage your stress as usual for the next eight weeks. You are currently using a more limited version of the app which gives you access to some features but not others. Starting today, you will use the app to complete a brief set of surveys every two weeks for eight weeks (five times total). After your participation in the study ends, you will be given the opportunity to try the Mindtrails intervention, and all of the app features will be unlocked. Ready to get started? Hit the Next button below to begin filling out questionnaires.
